title: Grand High Coven Gunge Stew
tagline: Thirteen witches stirred it. None of them washed their hands.

ingredients.item: witch's old sock, left-footed, extra whiffy

steps:
Round the cauldron, witches, creep; tip in bogeys, green and deep.
Stir widdershins, one, two, three, beneath the moon's wide grin with glee.

Toenails next, all nine, kerplunk! Into the sludge they smell and clunk.
Drop the sock, so old and grim; watch it wobble, swirl and swim.

Eyeballs now, both big and round; let them bob without a sound.
Sprinkle scales with a witchy sneeze; they'll sizzle in the bubbling breeze.

Cobweb floss goes in on top; wind it round the ladle, plop!
Pour the pus in, thirteen drips; smack your cackling, slimy lips.

Stir till the moon hides behind a cloud; chant the spell both low and loud.
Serve it up in a boot or a hat, and cackle, 'Now, how about that?'
rhyme:
Thirteen witches round the pot, stirring up a stinky lot!
In go bogeys, green and thick, picked by goblins, nice and quick.
Troll toenails, nine, go crunch and clack, then a sock that's gone all black.
Swamp sludge slops in, glug by glug, with a cyclops eyeball in each mug.
Dragon scales go ping and pop, cobweb floss goes on the top.
Moonbeam pus, a splash, a squirt, wipe your nose upon your shirt!
Stir it widdershins, thirteen times, and cackle out these gruesome rhymes.
Gloop, gloop, gloop, the brew is done. Who wants the sock? There's one for everyone!
image_prompt: A huge black cauldron brimming with lumpy glowing green stew, with two jelly cyclops eyeballs bobbing on top, curly troll toenails, shimmering dragon scales, a stripy old sock draped over the rim, and pink cobweb candyfloss swirled on top, with a wooden ladle standing in it.
alt_text: A black cauldron of glowing green lumpy stew topped with giant eyeballs, curly toenails, a stripy sock and pink cobweb candyfloss.
caption_hook:
A potion Roald Dahl would be proud of, stirred by thirteen witches with questionable hygiene.
Would you take the sock or the eyeball?
